description: Publishes a post immediately and publicly to the listed platforms through the social accounts connected to the user's PostWire account. A published post cannot be withdrawn from PostWire. Accepts one text for all platforms or a separate per_platform draft for each. YouTube requires video_url; TikTok requires video_url or photos (photo_url or media); Instagram requires a photo or video, and two or more media items make a carousel. Every platform must already be connected; otherwise nothing is published and the error names the missing ones. The same payload sent twice within 2 minutes is refused as a duplicate unless idempotency_key differs. When a platform is connected in more than one brand and brand_id is omitted, nothing is published and the error lists the brands. Returns { posted, published_to, results: [{ platform, ok, id?, url?, account?, error? }] }, where account and published_to name the handle and brand each post went to. The plan sets how many networks one post goes out to (Free: 2): only the first platforms in the list are published and each of the others comes back with ok: false, held: true and code networks_per_post (its version was written and not sent), listed in held_networks with a one-sentence held_message to relay to the user; every network can still be connected and written for. When the networks-per-post or the monthly post limit stops a platform, the result also names the plan that lifts it, its price and a checkout link.

brand_id.description: Which brand's accounts to use. Omit to use the default brand.

idempotency_key.description: Optional unique key; a repeat with the same key within 24 h is refused instead of posted twice.

media.description: Several images (or images and videos) in one post, in order: an Instagram carousel (up to 10), TikTok photo post (up to 35 images; PNG is converted to JPEG automatically for Instagram and TikTok), Bluesky (up to 4 images), Mastodon (up to 4), LinkedIn (up to 20 images, or one PDF document). Networks that take one item get the first. Each item: { url, type: image|video|document, alt? }.

alt.description: Alt text (used by Bluesky, Mastodon and LinkedIn).

url.description: Public https URL of the file.

photo_url.description: Public https URL of an image.

platforms.description: Platforms to publish to, all in one call, e.g. ["linkedin","bluesky"].

privacy.description: Who can see the TikTok and YouTube posts: public, unlisted (YouTube), friends (TikTok mutual followers) or private. Without it a TikTok post goes out private (only the account owner sees it) and YouTube uses the channel default — send "public" to publish publicly.

text.description: Post text used for every platform that has no per_platform draft.

video_url.description: Public https URL of a video. Required for YouTube; TikTok takes a video or photos.

name: post_to_social
title: Publish a post now
